record.field: ## Tool: Create Quotation Use after you have called "Get Quotation Parameters" and obtained the partner_id and product_ids. Pass the IDs from that tool along with the quantities extracted from the customer's message.
AI WhatsApp Sales: Send Inform Message

## Tool: Send Inform Message After you have called the "Create quotation" tool, send an inform message to the customer if the quotation creation was successful. Send an inform message to the customer with the quotation number.
## Tool: Product Search Search for products based on the product name to get the product ID. Use this tool only when you need to know the product ID for a product.
## Tool: Partner Search Search for partners based on the partner name to get the partner ID. Use this tool only when you need to know the partner ID for a partner.
